title: Putrajaya MRT and two Malaysian cities gain connected service accounts
summary: One regional railway and the distinct Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya municipal places connect staged opening, planning, street management and water services. Eligibility reaches 80 projects and 50 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Eleven official HTML bodies and three official indexed-text records inspected November 22; four substantive Malay sources have traceable AI interpretation. Direct retrieval limits, historical schedules and future targets remain explicit.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
